sections.heading: WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO PLAY
sections.middleText1: two single or multi-message switches record: "next" on one switch "there" on the other

sections.heading: HOW TO PLAY
sections.body:
1. Set up a game of Connect 4 or display on computer or tablet.
2. On the switch user's turn point to the first column.
3. If they press "next", move to the next column. If they press "there", put their counter in that column.
4. Keep playing until a player wins with 4 counters in a row!
